title: fix(service-datasource): serve the datasource driver form's labels and help in the requester's language
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DGazHPumEc1dceMjE3J1eEi)_

domain:server#1 card thread · session `session_016WV4czJVaL8SDBxjng4RLk` · branch `claude/project-thread-b5t886` (the card thread's platform-assigned branch, named in claim amendment 6670256081).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新建数据源对话框里的驱动名称、驱动说明和每个连接字段的标题与说明（文件名、自动迁移表结构、主机、端口等），现在由服务端按请求语言返回；平台语言表上的 11 种语言全部齐全（简体、繁体、西、阿、法、葡（巴西）、俄、德、日、韩，英文为源文），英文界面不变。
- 为什么改：这些文字全部来自 `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers`，控制台自己没有对应的翻译键，所以中文界面里这一块一直是英文，和对话框其他中文文字混在一起。
- 风险与回滚：只改返回的文字，驱动 id、图标、字段类型、默认值和校验都不变；繁体读者（zh-TW、zh-HK）拿到繁体，不会落到简体；平台表之外的语言和产品名照旧返回英文。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-datasource/src/driver-catalog.ts` 的 `driverCatalogLocaleOf` 与 `driverCatalogFor`；`src/driver-catalog-translations.ts` 的十种语言表；`src/admin-routes.ts` 里 drivers 路由那一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/driver-catalog.test.ts src/__tests__/admin-routes.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件 70 例全绿，其中 zh-CN 读到「文件名」，zh-TW 读到「檔案名稱」，fr-FR 读到 Nom de fichier，en-US 读到 Filename。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers` reads the requester's language the way the REST metadata door and the settings routes read it (the top `Accept-Language` tag, else a string `?locale=`) and serves `driverCatalogFor(locale)` instead of the fixed English `DRIVER_CATALOG`. The console already sends its own language as `Accept-Language` on every API call (`createAuthenticatedFetch` reads the html `lang` attribute), so no `ui/` change is needed.
- `driverCatalogLocaleOf` (new, `driver-catalog.ts`) reads the requested code through the platform locale table's own reader, `platformLocaleTagOf` (`@objectstack/spec/system`), shortened one subtag at a time (RFC 4647 lookup), the shape the storage connection test uses (PR #30627). So `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-MO` and `zh-Hant-TW` reach `zh-Hant` and never the Simplified text; `zh`, `zh-CN`, `zh-SG` and `zh-Hans-CN` reach `zh-Hans`; `pt` and `pt-PT` reach `pt-BR`; `fr-CA` reaches `fr`. `driverCatalogFor` overlays that language's entry `label` / `description` and each top-level field's JSON-Schema `title` / `description` on the English catalog. The spec's projected schema is copied, never written.
- `driver-catalog-translations.ts` (new) holds the translations, service-local beside the catalog's English curation, keyed by the platform table's tags. Every non-English language on the table (`zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`) covers all five offered drivers (In-Memory, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL / MariaDB, MongoDB) and every field word the form draws. Each language is written once as its distinct words and laid out per driver, so a field the drivers share (host, port, password) reads one way. Product names and technical terms (SQLite, URL, URI, SSL/TLS, `knex searchPath`, `application_name`) are kept as they are.
- Fallback: no locale, `en`, a code the platform table does not name (`it`, `nl-NL`), and the product-name labels are served the English text, never a key. A translation only replaces a word the English form shows; it never adds a title to a field that has none.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-datasource` patch.

## Tests

- `src/__tests__/driver-catalog.test.ts`, two new top-level describes. `driverCatalogFor`: Simplified Chinese words for SQLite (`文件名`, `自动迁移表结构`, the driver description) and the network drivers (`主机`, `端口`, `密码`); a SQLite `filename` title of its own in each of the ten languages, asserted against `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`; `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-MO`, `zh-Hant`, `zh-hant`, `zh-Hant-TW`, `zh-Hant-HK` reach `zh-Hant` (`檔案名稱`) and `zh`, `zh-CN`, `zh-cn`, `zh-SG`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hans-CN` reach `zh-Hans`; ten alias and regional codes (`ja-JP`, `es-MX`, `pt-PT`, `fr-CA`, …) reach their table language; ids, icons, field keys, types and defaults equal the English entry's in all eleven languages; `undefined`, empty, `en`, `en-US`, `en-GB`, `it`, `nl-NL`, `constructor`, `__proto__` return `DRIVER_CATALOG` itself; product-name labels stay English; the spec projection and `DRIVER_CATALOG` still read `Filename` after every language is served. `DRIVER_CATALOG_TRANSLATIONS coverage` walks `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`, not the table's keys: the table carries exactly the ten non-English languages; each names only drivers and fields the catalog serves; each translates every driver description, every non-product label and every field word the English form shows, so a missing language or a field the spec adds goes red.
- `src/__tests__/admin-routes.test.ts`, one new case on the real `HonoHttpServer`: `Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8` serves `文件名`, `自动迁移表结构`, `主机`, `端口` and the zh MySQL description with the English `SQLite` label; `?locale=zh-CN` with no header serves zh; `zh-TW,zh;q=0.9` serves `檔案名稱` and `連接埠`; `fr-FR,fr;q=0.9` serves `Nom de fichier`; `en-US` and `it-IT` serve `Filename` and `Host`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Languages.** All eleven languages on the platform locale table (`PLATFORM_LOCALES`), English as the source, per the maintainer's one-list ruling (no language tiers).
- **Out-of-scope finding (class a).** The dialog's own strings (the console's `studio` namespace: the dialog title, Name, Display name, Driver, Schema mode and its hints) exist in English and Chinese only (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/` holds `en.ts` and `zh.ts`), so a console in any of the other nine languages now reads these driver words in its own language inside an English dialog. Reach: the New datasource dialog under Setup, console language set to any table language other than en / zh-Hans; read from the tree, not measured live. Not fixed here (`ui/**` is outside this card's surface). Dedupe words: studio namespace locales, datasource dialog i18n, studio en zh only.
- **`?locale=` read.** The route now reads `?locale=` (string only, as the settings routes and the metadata door do). It had no query read before and declares no closed query set; converting this route to `refuseUnknownQueryParams` is not done here.
- **Stale translations are not detected.** If the spec revises an English field description, the zh-CN text stays as written; the coverage test catches added and removed fields, not revised wording. Noted, not filed.
- Nested schema words (the memory driver's persistence variants) are not translated: the dialog draws only top-level properties.
- `DRIVER_CATALOG` keeps its value and stays the English catalog; the QA checklist row that verifies the drivers body against it (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`) still holds for an English request.
